games.d: A small indie game about a first date that can go very wrong. Every dialogue choice matters, and the goal is to get through the evening in one piece.
The original version of 20 Minutes Till Dawn: survive until dawn against hordes of monsters. You aim your own shots, and each level-up lets you pick an upgrade.
A collection of duel mini-games for two players on the same keyboard: football, sumo, shooting, cars and more. Each round is very short and played with one button per player.
A Fortnite-style third-person shooter built around duels and building. You throw up walls, ramps and platforms in an instant to get the upper hand, online or against bots.
A survival roguelite where you hold out for 20 minutes against waves of Lovecraftian creatures. Pick a character and a weapon, then stack upgrades into devastating builds.
Gabriele Cirulli's famous puzzle game. Slide the tiles across the grid to merge matching numbers and reach the 2048 tile.
A runner where you steer a numbered cube. Collect cubes of the same value to merge them and reach the end of the track with the biggest number you can.
A 3D puzzle where you unscrew bolts in the right order to take an object apart piece by piece without getting stuck.
A game of 3D bowling: set your position, direction and power to knock down as many pins as you can over ten frames.
Eine Atombombe schlägt gleich ein: Du hast 60 Sekunden, um im Haus zusammenzuraffen, was geht, und in den Schutzraum zu kommen. Danach überlebst du Tag für Tag mit deiner Familie und teilst…
An eight-ball pool game. Aim, set your power and sink all of your balls before finishing on the black.
Miniclip's eight-ball pool, one of the most played pool games around. Aim, add spin and clear the table.
A turn-based brick breaker: fire a volley of balls to destroy numbered blocks before they reach the bottom of the screen.
A Five Nights at Freddy's fan game mixing point-and-click and horror. You spend an evening at Freddy's and the story takes an unexpected turn.

games.n: A Dance of Fire and Ice
games.f: A Dance of Fire and Ice
games.d: A minimalist rhythm game where two planets orbit each other. Tap in time to move along a path that follows the music.
A punishing climbing game in the spirit of Getting Over It. You only control your climber's hands, and one mistake can send you all the way back down.

games.n: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole
games.f: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole
games.d: A short incremental game where you feed a black hole. Smash asteroids, then planets and stars, and upgrade your abilities to make it grow.
A short horror exploration game set in an abandoned place. Move carefully and find out what happened here.
A Flash platformer where the only goal is to unlock 100 achievements, from obvious to absurd, as a little blue elephant.
The sequel to Achievement Unlocked, with even more achievements to earn in a bigger level full of secrets.
The third Achievement Unlocked: a larger world to explore and a mountain of achievements to collect.
An idle game where you start with a lemonade stand and build a capitalist empire. Hire managers to automate your businesses and watch the money pile up.
A 3D racing game with varied tracks and cars to upgrade. Win races to unlock new vehicles.
A war simulator where nations battle across a world map. Create countries, start conflicts and watch the borders shift.
The Behemoth's Flash run-and-gun that came before Castle Crashers. A little yellow alien crash-lands on Earth and blasts his way through FBI agents.
A horror game where you watch old tapes of a children's cartoon. Amanda and her sheep Wooly seem more and more aware of you, and the puzzles in the house take a sinister turn.
A relaxing puzzle where you roll a ball through a maze to paint every tile. The ball only stops when it hits a wall.
An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-10 players...in space!
A horror game disguised as a retro kids' game starring Andy the Apple and his friends. Behind the cute mini-games lie much darker secrets.
The browser version of Angry Birds released for Chrome. Same birds, same pigs, plus exclusive levels to smash with your slingshot.
A puzzle take on Angry Birds: match birds of the same color to launch attacks on the pigs.
The first Animal Crossing on GameCube. You move into a village of animal neighbors, pay off your house to Tom Nook and live through the seasons.
Ein explosiver Plattformer im Cartoon-Stil. Dynamite Anton zertrümmert jedes Level mit seinem Hammer und muss dann in vollem Tempo zurück.
A Bloons-style defense game where apes take on helium balloons. Place your defenses to stop the waves from getting through.
The fourth Ace Attorney, starring rookie lawyer Apollo Justice. Defend your clients in court, spot contradictions and read witnesses' nervous tells.
A water-slide race against other players. Take shortcuts by jumping over the edges and knock rivals off the track.
An archery game where you account for wind and distance to hit the bullseye across a series of tournaments.
A short horror game where you follow Arthur through a nightmare. Explore, pay attention and find a way to wake up.
You control a hole that swallows everything in its path. Grow by gobbling objects and enemies, then take on the level boss.
A chance-based plane mini-game: an aircraft takes off and stacks multipliers in flight, as long as it lands back on the carrier. Free version with no real money.
A top-down shooter where you drive a small tank. Destroy enemies, collect cash and upgrade your armor and weapons.
The sequel to Awesome Tanks, with new weapons, new enemies and bigger levels to clear.
A Nintendo 3DS emulator in the browser, based on the Azahar project (Citra's successor). You need to supply your own game files.
An exploration game based on the Backrooms internet legend. Wander endless yellowish corridors while trying to escape whatever lurks there.
A wacky beat 'em up where an armed pig fights hordes of evil bunnies. Expect combos, weapons and upgrades.
You play an ice cream scoop that has to collect all the fruit in the level while dodging monsters. Build and break ice walls to clear a path, alone or with a friend.
The sequel to Bad Ice Cream, with new levels, new fruit and trickier enemies. Still playable with two players.
The third Bad Ice Cream: more icy levels, flavors to unlock and two-player mode.
A bad-Monday simulator where you can wreck the office. Throw things around, smash the scenery and let off steam.
Ein kurzes psychologisches Horrorspiel in Pixelgrafik. Du begleitest einen kleinen Jungen, seine Familie und eine rotgesichtige Kreatur, die nachts auftaucht, in einer Geschichte darüber, w…
The pigs' side of Angry Birds: build makeshift vehicles from wheels, balloons and engines to get your pig to the finish.
A fan recreation of the Sans fight from Undertale. Dodge his bone and blaster attacks in this famously tough duel.
The original Baldi game: collect seven notebooks around the school without getting caught by a math teacher who speeds up with every wrong answer.
A remastered version of the original Baldi's Basics with extra modes and improvements, keeping the feel of the 2018 game.
Eine Parodie auf Lernspiele der 90er, die in Horror umschlägt. Du sammelst Hefte in einer Schule, ohne von Baldi erwischt zu werden, der mit jeder falschen Antwort schneller wird. Die Plus-…
A Baldi's Basics mod built on a decompilation of the game, adding content and options to the base game.
Steer a cannon that fires nonstop and destroy bouncing boulders before they crush you. Upgrade your fire rate and power between levels.
A heist game where you grab the bank's loot while fighting off security and the police.
The sequel to Bank Robbery, with new heists, more guns and more cops to shake off.
The third Bank Robbery: new places to rob and even more intense shootouts.
A Simpsons mini-game where Bart causes chaos with his slingshot. Hit the right targets to rack up points.
A fan-made platformer starring Bart Simpson, making his way through levels while dodging obstacles.
An arcade baseball game by Blue Wizard. Hit, run and pitch with special powers, solo or with a friend.
A one-on-one basketball duel. Jump, dribble and sink baskets before your opponent does.
A high-energy arcade basketball game by Blue Wizard: huge dunks, power-ups and one or two-player matches.
A chaotic physics basketball game with one button per player. The court, ball and players change after every point; play solo or with two.
Flick the ball to shoot and string together baskets without missing, from farther and farther away.
One-on-one basketball with stars to unlock. Dribble, shoot and block your opponent, against the computer or with a friend.
Crossover-Kampfspiel mit Figuren aus Dragon Ball Z, One Piece und Naruto in farbenfrohen Arenakämpfen.

games.d: A physics destruction game where a kid with a bazooka takes out enemies by bringing the scenery crashing down.
A rhythm game where you control a paddle around a central block. Catch notes on the beat in levels that each have their own visual style.

games.n: Bendy and the Ink Machine: ALL CHAPTERS
games.d: Bendy and the Ink Machine with all five chapters in one. Explore Joey Drew Studios to the end and uncover the whole story of the ink machine.
A parody fan game inspired by Deltarune and its Bergentrückung track, turned into a truck-themed gag.
A puzzle platformer by Cary Huang, based on the Battle for Dream Island web series. Control several characters and use them together to reach the exit.
A modded version of BFDIA 5b with a new set of levels, even harder than the original.
An icy take on Big Tower Tiny Square: climb a huge tower on slippery floors to rescue your pineapple.
Big Tower Tiny Square in neon: a new tower full of traps and pixel-perfect jumps, all in glowing colors.
A tiny square has to climb a giant tower to recover its stolen pineapple. A precision platformer with instant restarts and no loading screens.
The sequel to Big Tower Tiny Square, with an even taller tower, new mechanics and just as many precise jumps.
An online multiplayer FPS with voxel graphics. Pick a weapon and face other players in quick matches.
A text-based life simulator: from birth to death, every choice you make (school, career, relationships, mischief) shapes your life.
A small pixel-art plane game where you dodge and shoot down enemies in the sky.
The classic card game: get as close to 21 as you can without going over and beat the dealer. No real money.
Inspired by the Roblox game of the same name: an ever-faster ball homes in on players, and you have to parry it at the right moment to survive.
A block puzzle: place pieces on the grid to clear rows and columns without running out of space.
A voxel multiplayer FPS in the spirit of Counter-Strike. Teams, a range of weapons and blocky maps.
A blocky snake game: eat to grow and cut off other snakes without crashing.
A pitch-black clicker: a man agrees to be hurt for money, and every purchase gives you more violent ways to earn it. A disturbing look at greed, with several endings.
The very first Bloons Tower Defense: place dart-throwing monkeys along the path to pop the balloons before they get through.
Bloons Tower Defense 2, with new towers, upgrades and tougher balloons.
Bloons Tower Defense 3: more maps, more towers and ever-bigger waves of balloons.
Bloons Tower Defense 4, one of the most popular Flash entries, with upgrade paths and MOAB blimps.
Bloons TD 5, with tower specialties, special agents and dozens of maps. One of the most complete tower defense games around.
A 3D puzzle where you tip a rectangular block across a floating platform to drop it upright into the exit hole.
A small physics game from Blumgi: use your rocket launcher's recoil to blast yourself to the finish.
Der Zombies-Modus aus Call of Duty: Black Ops 1, nachgebaut für den Browser. Das Prinzip: So viele Runden wie möglich gegen Zombiewellen überleben, Waffen von der Wand kaufen und mit den ve…
Bob the robber sneaks into guarded buildings. Avoid guards and cameras, pick locks and get away with the loot.
A Worms-style turn-based artillery game. Aim, fire and use the destructible terrain to take out opponents, including other players.
Flip a bottle from object to object around the house and land it upright every time.
Smack a penguin as far as you can with a bat, then keep it bouncing to beat your record.
Archery duels (and plenty of other weapons) between wacky characters. Set your angle and power to hit your opponent before they hit you.
Unpredictable one-button physics boxing where the ring and rules change every round. Solo or with a friend.
A Fall Guys-style obstacle course: run, jump and survive the rounds to finish among the first.
A fan-made simulator inspired by Brawl Stars, where you pit brawlers against each other in a 3D arena.
A Mastermind-style puzzle: guess the secret pattern that unlocks the lock using the clues given after each attempt.
Diese Version von Brickstorm läuft direkt in deinem Browser, ohne Installation.
Collect bricks in your color to build stairs and climb to the top faster than your rivals.
An arena roguelite where a potato wielding up to six weapons fights waves of aliens. Pick items between waves to build a run that lasts.
Russisches Roulette mit einer Schrotflinte gegen den Dealer, in einem düsteren Hinterzimmer. Die Waffe ist mit scharfen und blinden Patronen geladen, und Gegenstände wie die Lupe oder die H…
A runner where you recruit soldiers through the right gates to build the biggest army you can before the final battle.
Put a plane together piece by piece, upgrade it and see how far it can fly.
A runner where you pick outfits and accessories along the way to be crowned queen at the finish.
An online building-focused shooter in the spirit of Fortnite. Throw up defenses in a flash and take on other players.
Diese Version von Bunny Hop läuft direkt in deinem Browser, ohne Installation.
Aggressives Arcade-Rennen, bei denen Kollisionen und Takedowns zur Strategie gehören, plus ein Crash-Modus mit Zerstörung im Mittelpunkt.

games.d: A launched wrestler flattens gummy bears to fly farther and farther. Upgrade him between launches to beat your records.
A small music game built around loops and rhythm, played by keeping to the beat.
A game styled like 90s and early 2000s cartoons, packed with fast mini-games and wild boss fights.
A sniper game where your targets blend into the scenery. Study every detail to spot and take them out.
King's famous match-3: line up three or more matching candies to meet each level's goals.
Fire cannonballs to topple every colorful structure in the level using as few shots as possible.
A physics puzzle where a cannon fires basketballs. Place the level's objects to guide the ball into the hoop.
The sequel to Cannon Basketball, with new levels and new objects to steer the ball into the hoop.
A car survival game: drive, ram enemies and upgrade your vehicle to last as long as possible.
Carrom, the Indian tabletop flick game: flick the striker to pocket your pieces in the corners before your opponent.

games.n: CaseOh's Basics in Eating and Fast Food
games.d: A parody fan game in the style of Baldi's Basics, built around streamer CaseOh and his love of food.
A cute puzzle where you link cats together by solving each grid.
A shooter where a squad of armed cats fends off zombie waves. Upgrade your cats and their weapons between levels.
Daisuke "Pixel" Amaya's indie classic. An amnesiac robot wakes up in a cave and discovers a floating island full of Mimigas, in a cult action-platform adventure.
Celeste begleitet Madeline beim Aufstieg auf einen Berg. Ein präziser Plattformer mit Sprung, Luftsprint und Hunderten kurzen Bildschirmen, dazu eine Geschichte über Angst. Neue Versuche st…
The Celeste prototype, made in four days on PICO-8. Climb the mountain across 30 levels with a jump and an air dash.
A cellular-automaton puzzle by Sam Hogan: place cells that push, rotate and duplicate to destroy the level's enemies.
An arcade football game: pick your team and play quick matches to win the tournament.
An AI chat tool you can use right in the browser. This one isn't a game.
Mice battle over cheese in a 3D arena: eat, grow and shove the others off the platform.
Inspired by the Cooper's Hill cheese race: tumble down a very steep hill chasing a wheel of cheese.
Classic chess: play against the computer at several difficulty levels or with two players on one screen.
A Suika Game-style merging game with the Chiikawa characters: drop and merge matching characters without overflowing.
A small pixel-art action game where an orc hacks his way through the levels with an axe.
A minimalist physics game where you rotate the level to guide a ball through circles and obstacles.
The sequel to CircloO, with new mechanics and more elaborate levels to rotate.
Defend your city against waves of enemies by placing and upgrading turrets.
A destruction sandbox: wreck a city with bombs, lasers, meteors and other ridiculous weapons.
A strategy game where you lead a Viking army: recruit warriors and take on rival clans.
A darkly comic visual novel set in a high school in 2009. You play Nicole, a cynical student, and your choices shape her relationships and the ending.
A management game where you run a clothing store: stock shelves, serve customers and expand your shop.
Eingesperrt in einem Raum musst du eine Schuld abbezahlen, indem du an einem Spielautomaten spielst. Glücksbringer ändern die Regeln und ermöglichen Kombos, und jede Drehung bringt die Fris…
The forerunner of Clustertruck: leap from truck to truck on a chaotic highway without ever touching the ground.
A first-person parkour game where you jump from truck to truck as they barrel through increasingly crazy levels.
A small HTML, CSS and JavaScript code editor with live preview, right in the browser. This one isn't a game.
Mix the right colors to match the requested shade exactly in each level.
A sorting puzzle: pour liquids between tubes until each tube holds a single color.
Westwood's first Command & Conquer (1995). The GDI battles the Brotherhood of Nod over Tiberium in a genre-defining real-time strategy game.
Orteil's incremental game: click a giant cookie, buy grandmas, factories and portals to bake billions of cookies.
The Nintendo DS cooking game: chop, mix and cook ingredients by following Mama's instructions.
Cooking Mama 2 on DS, with new recipes and meals to cook for your friends.
Cooking Mama 3 on DS: go grocery shopping, then cook dozens of new recipes.
A car runner: dodge obstacles, collect bonuses and upgrade your car.
Stick all your pins into a spinning circle without hitting the ones already there. A simple and brutal timing test.
A runner where you grow your crowd of stickmen through the right gates, then crush the enemy army.
Diese Version von Crash Bash läuft direkt in deinem Browser, ohne Installation.
Kart-Rennen mit Crash und seinen Rivalen, bunten Strecken, Abkürzungen und Power-ups.

An absurd physics battle royale where sheep ram each other to be the last one standing.
A 3D arcade game where you steer a crazy chicken through levels full of obstacles.
A 3D arcade game where you control a wild cat causing chaos.
Hipster Whale's modern Frogger: cross roads, rivers and rail tracks without getting flattened, as far as you can.
A deliberately garish, unsettling immersive sim. You're a corporate hitman in an absurd hyper-capitalist world, with missions you can solve in countless ways.
Crush and wreck cars with all kinds of machines to earn money and unlock new tools.
Surf ist ein Modus aus Counter-Strike: Es wird nicht geschossen, du rutschst über schräge Rampen und hältst mit Luftbewegungen deine Geschwindigkeit. Ziel ist es, die Karte so schnell wie m…
A Flash classic: a tiny ship speeds through a field of cubes you have to dodge with the arrow keys.
Ein Run-and-Gun-Spiel, gezeichnet wie ein Cartoon der 30er-Jahre. Cuphead und Mugman haben eine Wette gegen den Teufel verloren und müssen bei einer Reihe harter Bosse Schulden eintreiben.
Cut the ropes at the right moment to drop the candy into Om Nom's mouth, grabbing all three stars on the way.
Another version of ZeptoLab's puzzle: cut ropes and use bubbles and air cushions to feed Om Nom.
The Christmas edition of Cut the Rope, with festive levels where Om Nom waits for his candy under the tree.
Om Nom travels through time and feeds his ancestors in different eras, with two mouths to feed in each level.
Highly unstable beta: performance-heavy, with possible bugs/crashes. First load may lag; assets are cached afterward.
A retro platformer where Dadish, a radish dad, searches for his lost kids through levels full of hostile junk food.
The sequel to Dadish, with new worlds, new bosses and more baby radishes to find.
Dadish 3: Dadish sets off again through more varied and more demanding levels.
Dadish jumps into 3D in an old-school, 90s-style platformer.
A Dadish game with a new level to beat every day of the year.

The dalgona candy challenge from Squid Game: carve out the shape without breaking the cookie.
A retro platform brawler by Halfbrick. Dan, a reluctant hero, chains punches, weapons and boss fights in an 8-bit style.
A short psychological horror game: you work as a waiter in a fancy restaurant and the chef is hiding something. Several endings depending on your choices.
Rush through a tunnel at top speed dodging the blocks that appear in front of you. A very fast reflex game.
Straßenkämpfe im Hip-Hop-Umfeld mit verschiedenen Kampfstilen, Rappern und Wrestlern an Schauplätzen der Stadt.

A fan game inspired by Undertale and Deltarune, with its own story, characters and bullet-hell fights.
A runner where the gates you pick shape your life, for better or worse.
Wreck a car in every way possible with weapons and traps to earn money.
Blizzards erstes Diablo von 1996. Du steigst Stockwerk um Stockwerk unter die Kathedrale von Tristram hinab, um Diablo zu stellen. Echtzeitkämpfe, zufällige Beute und Dungeons, die jedes Ma…
Dig deeper and deeper to find diamonds and upgrade your gear.
A dice roguelite: build the best set of dice to reach a million points.
Dig a path through the ground to guide objects to the treasure buried below.
A small indie puzzle game about dimensions getting mixed up.

games.f: Do NOT Take This Cat Home
games.d: A horror game where you take in a stray cat. This cat isn't quite normal, and living together soon gets unsettling.

Draw your character's legs so it can climb and move forward. Redraw them for each terrain to win the race.
Draw your own weapon or vehicle, then charge into a joust against your opponent.
Draw the road as you go so your car gets over obstacles without crashing.
Draw a single line to solve each little physics puzzle.
A parkour game where you run, slide and leap at full speed through obstacle-packed levels.
A one-button drift game: turn at the right moment to stay on a zigzag road hanging over the void.
A 3D drift simulator: chain slides to earn money, buy cars and tune them in the garage.
A small racing game by KilledByAPixel, built in very little code, where you speed down a wild road.
Train your duck at running, swimming and flying through mini-games, then enter it in races to win the championship.
The sequel to Duck Life, with new training events and a world tour of races.
Duck Life 3: Evolution adds genetics: raise ducks with different abilities to win races.
Duck Life 4: train your duck, customize it and take on the champions of several regions.
Duck Life 5: Treasure Hunt mixes training, racing and treasure hunting to save the farm.
Duck Life 8: Adventure goes 3D with an open world to explore, quests and, of course, duck races.
The mini-games from the cult Melbourne Metro safety campaign: save the characters from one silly death after another.
A digital toy: stretch and squish a man's rubbery face with your mouse.
A multi-console emulator in the browser (NES, SNES, GBA, N64 and more). Load your own ROMs to play.
A point-and-click styled like old educational software, with horror creeping in underneath.
A survival horror game where your character has only one arm and reloads every weapon step by step. Infected, he fights through a parasite-ridden lab.

tx.d.perf: Schaltet Unschärfe, Schatten und Animationen ab. Empfohlen auf Fernseher, Streaming-Box oder schwachem PC.
tx.perf.title: Leistungsmodus einschalten?
tx.perf.body: Dein Gerät wirkt eher schwach (Fernseher, Streaming-Box oder kleiner PC). Der Leistungsmodus schaltet visuelle Effekte ab: flüssigere Bedienung und mehr Leistung für Spiele. Jederzeit änderbar unter Einstellungen → Oberfläche.
tx.ext.title: Externes Spiel
tx.ext.body: {name} läuft nicht im PlayTab-Player: Es öffnet sich in einem neuen Tab, außerhalb des Big-Picture-Modus.
tx.kbm.title: Nicht controllertauglich
tx.kbm.body: {name} ist nicht mit dem Controller spielbar: Du brauchst Tastatur und Maus. Trotzdem starten?
tx.t.couch: {n} Controller verbunden: Mehrspieler-Spiele auf der Startseite
tx.inst.how: Wähle im Browsermenü „App installieren“. Big Picture öffnet sich dann im Vollbild.
tx.d.install: Fügt ein Big-Picture-Symbol auf Computer oder Fernseher hinzu.
tx.t.perf: Animationen reduziert für flüssigere Bedienung (änderbar in den Einstellungen).
tx.mob.title: Big Picture kommt bald aufs Handy
tx.mob.body: Der Big-Picture-Modus ist vorerst nur am Computer (PC oder Mac) verfügbar. Auf Handy und Tablet nutzt du einfach die PlayTab-Website: Dort sind alle Spiele.
tx.tut.title: Dein Controller in PlayTab
tx.tut.home.title: Die mittlere Taste öffnet das Menü
tx.tut.home.body: Drücke im Spiel {home} (die mittlere Taste deines Controllers), um das PlayTab-Menü zu öffnen.
tx.tut.home.none: Die mittlere Taste kommt nicht bei PlayTab an.
tx.tut.steam: Steam, die Xbox Game Bar oder dein Browser fangen diese Taste wohl ab. Wähle im nächsten Schritt eine Ersatz-Tastenkombination: Sie funktioniert auch mit geöffnetem Steam.
tx.tut.steam.soft: Wenn Steam läuft, kann es diese Taste abfangen. Die Ersatz-Kombination löst das.
tx.tut.bind.title: Deine Ersatz-Kombination
tx.tut.bind.body: Neben der mittleren Taste wählst du eine Taste, die das Menü ebenfalls öffnet, wenn du sie 2 Sekunden hältst. Nimm eine Taste, die Spiele selten nutzen (L3, R3, Ansicht…): Das Spiel empfängt sie auch.
tx.tut.bind.hold: Halte die gewünschte Taste 2 Sekunden lang…
tx.tut.bind.ishome: Das ist schon die mittlere Taste: wähle eine andere.
tx.tut.bind.single: Spiele nutzen diese Taste oft. L3, R3 oder Ansicht verhindern, dass sich das Menü versehentlich öffnet.
tx.tut.test.title: Teste deine Kombination
tx.tut.test.body: Halte sie wie im Spiel: Der Kreis füllt sich, dann würde sich das Menü öffnen.
tx.tut.test.ok: Perfekt! Im Spiel öffnet diese Kombination das PlayTab-Menü.
tx.d.qbind: Halte diese Taste im Spiel 2 Sekunden, um das PlayTab-Menü zu öffnen. Standard: die rechte Taste (B, ○ oder A). Drücke hier, um eine andere zu wählen.
tx.dock.hint: Steam oder eine andere App fängt die Home-Taste ab? Nutze diese Leiste mit der Maus oder Ansicht + Menü am Controller.
tx.ad.thanks.body: Du hilfst, PlayTab kostenlos zu halten. Schließe den Werbe-Tab und starte dein Spiel.
tx.d.glyphs: Symbole in der unteren Leiste und den Menüs. „Auto“ folgt dem angeschlossenen Controller.
tx.d.swap: Tauscht A und B. „Auto“ nur bei Nintendo-Controllern.
tx.d.vib: Kleine Vibrationen beim Bewegen und Bestätigen (falls Controller und Browser es können).
tx.d.dz: Wie weit der Stick bewegt werden muss. Erhöhen, wenn sich der Cursor von selbst bewegt.
tx.d.detect: Auf der normalen Seite schlägt ein Fenster Big Picture vor, wenn ein Controller angeschlossen wird.
tx.d.auto: Auf der normalen Seite öffnet ein Controller Big Picture sofort.
tx.d.sounds: Kleine Töne beim Navigieren und Bestätigen.
tx.d.scale: Vergrößert oder verkleinert die ganze Oberfläche.
tx.d.autofs: Vollbild beim ersten Klick oder Tastendruck.
tx.d.test: Tasten drücken und Sticks bewegen: Alles leuchtet hier auf.
tx.d.lang: Lädt Big Picture in dieser Sprache neu.
tx.after.title: Wie war {name}?
tx.after.pad: Lässt es sich mit Controller spielen?
tx.welcome.title: Willkommen bei Big Picture
tx.welcome.lead: PlayTab im Vollbild, zum Spielen vom Sofa aus. Bitte vorher abhaken:
tx.welcome.c1: Ich weiß, dass die Controller-Steuerung nicht bei allen Spielen getestet wurde: Manche gehen nur mit Tastatur und Maus.
tx.welcome.c2: Ich weiß, dass Big Picture eine Beta ist und ich Fehler im Menü melden kann (Taste {menu}).
tx.welcome.c3: Nach einem Spiel sage ich, ob es mit Controller geht: Das Abzeichen „Controller-tauglich“ hilft anderen.
tx.welcome.need: Hake alle drei Kästchen ab, um weiterzumachen.
tx.fb.title: Was möchtest du uns sagen?
tx.fb.lead: Big Picture ist in der Beta: Jede Rückmeldung hilft uns.
tx.fb.ph: Hier schreiben (optional, wenn du ein Thema gewählt hast)
tx.fb.ph.idea: z. B. Spiele nach Reihe sortieren
tx.fb.ctx: Automatisch angehängt: Bildschirm, Controller, Browser (nichts Persönliches).
tx.fb.thanks: Danke! Deine Nachricht ist beim PlayTab-Team angekommen.
tx.fb.err: Senden gerade nicht möglich. Versuch es später.
tx.fb.empty: Schreib ein paar Worte oder wähle ein Thema.
tx.exit.title: Big Picture beenden?
tx.exit.body: Du kehrst zur PlayTab-Startseite zurück. Favoriten und zuletzt gespielte Spiele bleiben gespeichert.
tx.home.title: Big-Picture-Modus
tx.home.body: Mach deinen Browser zur Konsole: PlayTab im Vollbild, für den Fernseher gemacht, mit Controller, Tastatur oder Maus.
tx.home.pads: Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Wii U… oder ganz ohne Controller
tx.s.swap.note: Auto: Bei Nintendo-Controllern (Switch, Wii U) bestätigt A, die rechte Taste, wie auf ihrer Konsole.
tx.title: PlayTab Big Picture
tx.d.stats: Hilft, Big Picture zu verbessern: geöffnete Bildschirme, gestartete Spiele, ohne Cookies und ohne dich zu erkennen.
tx.d.privacy: Welche Daten Big Picture nutzt, wozu und wie du sie löschst.
